## What the status means

- **live-tested**: the actions were run against the real API with a real account.
- **docs-based**: written from the provider's official documentation and tested against a fake server, but **not run against the real service**. It may contain small mistakes (a field name, a scope). Please [report them](https://github.com/itzzzzzzak/connector-kit/issues/new/choose). Verifying one against a real account and sending the result is one of the most useful contributions you can make: see [writing-connectors.md](writing-connectors.md).

## Actions

### Airtable (`airtable`)

List bases and tables, and read, create, update and delete records.

- `bases.list` (read): List the Airtable bases the token can access.
- `tables.list` (read): List the tables in a base with their fields and field types.
- `records.list` (read): List records in a table.
- `records.get` (read): Get one record by id (starts with "rec").
- `records.create` (write): Create one record in a table.
- `records.update` (write): Update some fields of one record; fields you do not mention are left as they are.
- `records.delete` (destructive): Permanently DELETE one record from a table.

### Calendly (`calendly`)

Read the user's event types, scheduled meetings and invitees, and cancel meetings.

- `users.me` (read): Get the authenticated Calendly user.
- `eventTypes.list` (read): List event types (the kinds of meetings people can book, e.g.
- `scheduledEvents.list` (read): List scheduled meetings.
- `scheduledEvents.get` (read): Get one scheduled meeting by its uuid (the last part of its URI).
- `scheduledEvents.invitees.list` (read): List the people invited to a scheduled meeting, with their email and status.
- `scheduledEvents.cancel` (destructive): CANCEL a scheduled meeting.

### Cloudflare (`cloudflare`)

Manage Cloudflare zones, DNS records and the cache, and list accounts and Workers scripts with a scoped API token.

- `token.verify` (read): Check that the API token is valid and active.
- `accounts.list` (read): List the Cloudflare accounts the token can see.
- `zones.list` (read): List zones (domains) the token can see, optionally filtered by name, status or account.
- `zone.get` (read): Get a zone by id: its status, name servers and plan.
- `zoneSettings.list` (read): List a zone's settings (SSL mode, minimum TLS version, always-use-HTTPS, caching level and more) with their current values.
- `dnsRecords.list` (read): List a zone's DNS records, optionally filtered by type, name or content.
- `dnsRecord.get` (read): Get one DNS record by id, with its type, name, content, TTL and whether it is proxied.
- `dnsRecord.create` (write): Create a DNS record.
- `dnsRecord.update` (write): Change fields of an existing DNS record (only the fields you give).
- `dnsRecord.delete` (destructive): Delete a DNS record.
- `cache.purge` (destructive): Purge cached content for a zone: everything, or only the given URLs, hosts, tags or prefixes.
- `workers.list` (read): List the Workers scripts in an account, with when each was last modified.

### Confluence (`confluence`)

Search, read, create and edit Confluence Cloud pages and comments, and list spaces.

- `spaces.list` (read): List Confluence spaces the user can see, optionally filtered by key or type.
- `space.get` (read): Get one space by id: its key, name, type and status.
- `pages.list` (read): List pages, newest first by default, optionally only those in given spaces or with a given title.
- `page.get` (read): Get one page by id: title, space, parent, version number and, when you ask for a body format, its content.
- `pageChildren.list` (read): List the direct child pages of a page.
- `comments.list` (read): List the footer comments on a page, oldest first, with their text in storage format.
- `search.cql` (read): Search content with CQL, such as: type = page AND space = ENG AND text ~ "onboarding" ORDER BY lastmodified DESC.
- `page.create` (write): Create a page in a space, optionally under a parent page.
- `page.update` (write): Replace a page's title and body.
- `page.delete` (destructive): Move a page to the trash, or with purge delete a page that is already in the trash for good.
- `comment.create` (write): Add a footer comment to a page, as the authenticated user.

### Linear (`linear`)

Search, read, create and update issues, comments, projects, cycles and documents in Linear, over its GraphQL API.

- `viewer.get` (read): Get the user the credentials belong to (who am I in Linear).
- `organization.get` (read): Get the Linear workspace (organization) the credentials belong to.
- `teams.list` (read): List the teams in the workspace.
- `team.get` (read): Get one team by id, with its key, name and description.
- `users.list` (read): List the people in the workspace.
- `user.get` (read): Get one person in the workspace by their id.
- `issues.list` (read): List issues, optionally filtered, newest updated first.
- `issue.get` (read): Get one issue by id or identifier (such as ENG-123), with its state, assignee, project and labels.
- `searchIssues.list` (read): Search issues by text (title, description, comments).
- `issue.create` (write): Create an issue in a team.
- `issue.update` (write): Change an issue: title, description, state, assignee, priority, labels, project or due date.
- `issue.archive` (write): Archive an issue (hides it from lists; it can be restored in Linear).
- `issue.delete` (destructive): Delete an issue: it moves to the trash and is permanently removed after the workspace's retention period.
- `comments.list` (read): List the comments on an issue.
- `comment.create` (write): Add a comment to an issue.
- `projects.list` (read): List projects, optionally filtered.
- `project.get` (read): Get one project by id, with its state, progress, lead and dates.
- `project.create` (write): Create a project for one or more teams.
- `workflowStates.list` (read): List workflow states (Backlog, In Progress, Done, ...).
- `issueLabels.list` (read): List issue labels, optionally filtered.
- `cycles.list` (read): List cycles (sprints), optionally filtered by team or dates.
- `documents.list` (read): List documents, optionally filtered.
- `document.get` (read): Get one document by id, with its Markdown content.

### Microsoft Teams (`microsoft-teams`)

List teams, channels and chats, read messages and post messages in Microsoft Teams as the signed-in user, through Microsoft Graph.

- `teams.list` (read): List the teams the signed-in user belongs to, with their ids.
- `channels.list` (read): List the channels of a team, with their ids.
- `channelMessages.list` (read): List recent messages in a channel (top-level posts, newest first), not their replies.
- `channelMessages.send` (write): Post a message to a channel as the signed-in user.
- `chats.list` (read): List the signed-in user's chats (one-on-one, group and meeting chats), most recently active first.
- `chatMessages.list` (read): List recent messages in a chat, newest first.
- `chatMessages.send` (write): Send a message in a chat as the signed-in user.

### monday.com (`monday`)

Read monday.com boards, items and updates, create and change items, post updates, and list users, through the GraphQL API.

- `me.get` (read): Get the user the token belongs to and their account.
- `users.list` (read): List the users in the account (id, name, email, role flags).
- `boards.list` (read): List active boards, most recently used first.
- `board.get` (read): Get one board with its columns (id, title, type) and groups.
- `items.list` (read): List the first page of items on a board with their column values.
- `items.next` (read): Get the next page of items using the cursor from items.list or a previous items.next.
- `item.get` (read): Get one item by id with its group, board and column values.
- `updates.list` (read): List the updates (comments) on an item, newest first, as plain text and HTML.
- `item.create` (write): Create an item on a board, optionally in a group and with column values.
- `item.changeColumns` (write): Change several column values of an item at once (status, dates, people, text...).
- `update.create` (write): Post an update (comment) on an item as the token's user.
- `item.archive` (destructive): Archive an item: it disappears from the board and is deleted for good after 30 days unless restored in the app.
- `item.delete` (destructive): Delete an item.

### Notion (`notion`)

Search and read pages, databases and blocks, and create or update pages, content, data sources and comments.

- `users.list` (read): List the people and bots in the workspace.
- `users.get` (read): Get one workspace user (a person or a bot) by id.
- `users.getMe` (read): Get the bot user for this token, with the workspace it belongs to.
- `search` (read): Search the pages and data sources shared with the integration, by title.
- `pages.get` (read): Get a page's properties and metadata (not its content: use blocks.listChildren for that).
- `pages.create` (write): Create a page, either under another page or as a row in a data source.
- `pages.update` (write): Change a page's properties, icon or cover, or move it to the trash (in_trash true) or restore it (false).
- `pages.move` (write): Move a page under a different parent page or data source.
- `pages.getProperty` (read): Get one property of a page by property id, with every item of a long list property (relations, rollups, people).
- `pages.getMarkdown` (read): Read a page's whole content as Markdown.
- `pages.updateMarkdown` (write): Edit a page's content with Markdown: replace all of it, or update, insert or replace a part.
- `blocks.get` (read): Get one block (a paragraph, heading, to-do, ...) by id, with its text.
- `blocks.listChildren` (read): List the blocks inside a page or block: this is a page's content.
- `blocks.appendChildren` (write): Add blocks to the end of a page or block (or after a given block).
- `blocks.update` (write): Change a block's content, e.g.
- `blocks.delete` (destructive): Delete a block by moving it to the trash.
- `comments.list` (read): List the open comments on a page or block.
- `comments.create` (write): Add a comment to a page, or reply in an existing discussion thread (discussion_id).
- `databases.get` (read): Get a database container by id: its title and the list of data sources inside it.
- `dataSources.get` (read): Get a data source (a table of pages) by id, with its property schema: the names and types needed to filter it or create rows.
- `dataSources.query` (read): Query the rows (pages) of a data source with an optional filter and sort.
- `dataSources.create` (write): Create a data source (a table) under a page, with its property schema.
- `dataSources.update` (write): Change a data source's title or property schema.
- `dataSources.listTemplates` (read): List the page templates of a data source.

### OneDrive (Microsoft 365) (`onedrive`)

Browse, search and organize files and folders in a user's OneDrive, and create sharing links, through Microsoft Graph.

- `drive.get` (read): Get the user's OneDrive: its id, type and storage quota (used and remaining bytes).
- `children.list` (read): List the files and folders inside a folder.
- `item.get` (read): Get the metadata of one file or folder by id (name, size, type, location, web link).
- `items.search` (read): Search the user's OneDrive by file name and content.
- `folder.create` (write): Create a folder inside another folder (parentId is a folder id, or "root").
- `item.rename` (write): Rename a file or folder.
- `item.createLink` (write): Create a sharing link for a file or folder.
- `item.delete` (destructive): Delete a file or folder (it moves to the OneDrive recycle bin, where it can be restored for a limited time).

### Outlook (Microsoft 365) (`outlook`)

Read, search, draft and send Outlook mail, manage calendar events and find free time, and read contacts through Microsoft Graph.

- `me.get` (read): Get the signed-in user's profile (name, email address, id).
- `mailFolders.list` (read): List the user's top-level mail folders (Inbox, Sent Items, Drafts, ...) with their ids and unread counts.
- `messages.list` (read): List messages in a folder, newest first (the folder is "inbox" by default; a well-known name like "sentitems" or "drafts", or a folder id).
- `message.get` (read): Get one message by id, with its body (HTML or text).
- `drafts.create` (write): Save a draft message without sending it.
- `messages.send` (write): Send an email from the user's mailbox to the listed people.
- `message.delete` (destructive): Delete a message (it moves to Deleted Items).
- `events.list` (read): List calendar events that fall between two times, with recurring events expanded.
- `event.get` (read): Get one calendar event by id, with its attendees and times.
- `events.create` (write): Create a calendar event.
- `event.delete` (destructive): Delete a calendar event from the user's calendar.
- `schedule.get` (read): Find when people are free or busy between two times, to pick a meeting slot.
- `contacts.list` (read): List the user's personal contacts (name, email addresses, phone numbers).

### QuickBooks (`quickbooks`)

Read QuickBooks Online customers, invoices and company data with SELECT queries, create customers and invoices, and void invoices.

- `company.get` (read): Get the company's name, legal name, country, fiscal year start and email.
- `query.run` (read): Run a read-only QuickBooks query, such as: select * from Bill where Balance > '0' startposition 1 maxresults 50.
- `customers.list` (read): List customers, optionally only active ones or those whose display name contains some text.
- `customer.get` (read): Get one customer by id, including the SyncToken you need to update it.
- `invoices.list` (read): List invoices, newest first, optionally for one customer, only unpaid ones, or from a date on.
- `invoice.get` (read): Get one invoice by id with its lines, totals, balance and the SyncToken you need to void it.
- `customer.create` (write): Create a customer.
- `invoice.create` (write): Create an invoice for a customer from item lines (item id, quantity, unit price).
- `invoice.void` (destructive): Void an invoice: its amounts are set to zero and it no longer counts in the books, but the record stays.

### Resend (`resend`)

Send transactional email with Resend, check whether an email was delivered, and list sent emails and sending domains.

- `emails.send` (write): Send an email from a verified domain.
- `email.get` (read): Get a sent email by id, including its last delivery event (delivered, bounced, complained, opened, clicked).
- `emails.list` (read): List recently sent emails, newest first, with their last delivery event.
- `email.cancel` (destructive): Cancel a scheduled email before it is sent.
- `domains.list` (read): List the sending domains with their verification status.
- `domain.get` (read): Get one sending domain by id, with the DNS records that must exist for it to verify.

### Salesforce (`salesforce`)

Query Salesforce with SOQL and SOSL, and read, create, update, upsert and delete records of any object (Account, Contact, Opportunity, custom objects).

- `records.query` (read): Run a SOQL query and return the matching records, up to 2,000 per page; pass nextCursor for the next page.
- `records.queryAll` (read): Like records.query, but also returns deleted and archived records (IsDeleted = true).
- `records.search` (read): Run a SOSL text search across objects, e.g.
- `record.get` (read): Get one record by object and id.
- `record.create` (write): Create a record of an object.
- `record.update` (write): Change fields of a record.
- `record.upsert` (write): Create or update a record found by an external id field (a field marked External Id on the object).
- `record.delete` (destructive): Delete a record.
- `sobjects.list` (read): List the objects in the org (standard and custom) with their API names and whether they can be queried, created, updated and deleted.
- `sobject.describe` (read): Describe an object: its fields with types, lengths, required-ness, picklist values and relationships.
- `limits.get` (read): Get the org's API limits with what is used and what remains (daily API requests, bulk, storage).

### SendGrid (`sendgrid`)

Send email with Twilio SendGrid, list email templates, read bounces, and see delivery statistics.

- `mail.send` (write): Send an email to up to 1000 recipients.
- `templates.list` (read): List dynamic email templates with their versions.
- `template.get` (read): Get one template by id, with its versions.
- `bounces.list` (read): List email addresses whose mail bounced (newest first), with the reason.
- `stats.get` (read): Get global email statistics (requests, delivered, opens, clicks, bounces, spam reports) between two dates, by day, week or month.
- `user.profile` (read): Get the account profile that owns the API key.

### Shopify (`shopify`)

Read and manage products, orders, customers and locations in a Shopify store through the Admin GraphQL API, with an escape hatch for the rest of the schema.

- `shop.get` (read): Get the shop's name, domain, plan, currency and time zone.
- `locations.list` (read): List the shop's locations (stores, warehouses) with their ids.
- `products.list` (read): List products, optionally filtered with Shopify search syntax.
- `product.get` (read): Get one product by global id, with its variants, prices, SKUs and stock.
- `product.create` (write): Create a product (a draft unless status is ACTIVE).
- `product.update` (write): Change a product's title, description, vendor, type, tags or status.
- `product.delete` (destructive): Permanently delete a product and its variants and media.
- `orders.list` (read): List orders, optionally filtered with Shopify search syntax (financial_status:paid fulfillment_status:unfulfilled).
- `order.get` (read): Get one order by global id: status, totals, customer and line items.
- `order.update` (write): Change an order's note or tags.
- `customers.list` (read): List customers, optionally filtered with Shopify search syntax (email:ada@acme.dev, tag:vip).
- `customer.get` (read): Get one customer by global id: name, email, phone, tags, order count.
- `customer.create` (write): Create a customer.
- `customer.update` (write): Change a customer's name, email, phone, note or tags.
- `graphql.query` (read): Run any read-only GraphQL query against the Admin API, for what the other actions do not cover (inventory levels, metafields, collections, discounts).
- `graphql.mutate` (destructive): Run any GraphQL mutation against the Admin API, for changes the other actions do not cover (inventory, fulfilment, refunds, discounts, variants, deleting things).

### Telegram (`telegram`)

Send, edit and delete Telegram messages and photos as a bot, read the messages sent to it, and manage its webhook.

- `me.get` (read): Get the bot's own account (id and username).
- `updates.get` (read): Read the messages and events sent to the bot since an offset, oldest first.
- `chat.get` (read): Get a chat the bot is in: its type, title, username and description.
- `messages.send` (write): Send a text message to a chat as the bot.
- `photos.send` (write): Send a photo to a chat as the bot, from a public https URL or a file_id Telegram already holds.
- `messages.edit` (write): Change the text of a message the bot sent.
- `messages.forward` (write): Forward a message from one chat to another as the bot.
- `messages.delete` (destructive): Delete a message.
- `chat.leave` (destructive): Make the bot leave a group, supergroup or channel.
- `webhook.get` (read): Get the bot's webhook: its URL, how many updates are waiting and the last delivery error.
- `webhook.set` (write): Send the bot's updates to an https URL instead of polling.
- `webhook.delete` (destructive): Remove the bot's webhook so updates.get works again.

### Twilio Lookups (`twilio-lookups`)

Validate and format phone numbers and look up line type, carrier and fraud-risk data for them with Twilio Lookup.

- `bulkLookup.create` (write): In Request Bulk.
- `lookupAccountRateLimits.fetch` (read): Get account rate limits.
- `lookupPhoneNumberOverrides.fetch` (read): Get Overrides for a Phone Number for a specific field.
- `lookupPhoneNumberOverrides.create` (write): Create Override for a Phone Number for a specific field.
- `lookupPhoneNumberOverrides.update` (write): Update Override for a Phone Number for a specific field.
- `lookupPhoneNumberOverrides.delete` (destructive): Delete an Override for a Phone Number for a specific field
- `lookupRateLimit.fetch` (read): Get rate limit Calls GET /v2/RateLimits/Fields/{Field}/Bucket/{Bucket} on Twilio Lookups.
- `lookupRateLimit.update` (write): Upsert rate limit Calls PUT /v2/RateLimits/Fields/{Field}/Bucket/{Bucket} on Twilio Lookups.
- `lookupRateLimit.delete` (destructive): Delete rate limit Calls DELETE /v2/RateLimits/Fields/{Field}/Bucket/{Bucket} on Twilio Lookups.
- `phoneNumbers.lookup` (read): Validate a phone number and get its formatted forms and country.

### WhatsApp (`whatsapp`)

Send WhatsApp messages, templates and media from a business number through Meta's Cloud API, and read the account's phone numbers, templates and business profile.

- `phoneNumbers.list` (read): List the business phone numbers of a WhatsApp Business Account, with their display number, verified name and quality rating.
- `phoneNumber.get` (read): Get one business phone number: its display number, verified name, quality rating, messaging limit tier and status.
- `businessProfile.get` (read): Get a business number's public WhatsApp profile: about text, address, description, email, website and category.
- `templates.list` (read): List the message templates of a WhatsApp Business Account with their name, language, category and approval status.
- `media.get` (read): Get the temporary download URL, type and size of a media file that a customer sent (use the media id from the incoming message).
- `messages.sendText` (write): Send a text message from a business number.
- `messages.sendTemplate` (write): Send an approved message template (the only kind of message allowed outside the 24 hour window).
- `messages.sendMedia` (write): Send an image, document, video or audio file from a public https link.
- `messages.markRead` (write): Mark an incoming message as read, which shows the customer the blue ticks.
